description: Generate complete truth tables for AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, NOR, IMPLIES and XNOR over 2 or 3 variables, with every row genuinely evaluated.

faqs.a: A truth table lists every possible combination of true/false inputs for a logical expression and the resulting output of each row. For n variables there are 2^n rows.

faqs.q: What do tautology and contradiction mean?
faqs.a: A tautology is an expression that is true in every row; a contradiction is false in every row. Anything in between is a contingency. The generator classifies your expression automatically.
A → B is false only when A is true and B is false; in all other rows it is true. It is logically equivalent to (¬A ∨ B).

howto: Pick a logical expression such as AND, XOR, IMPLIES or a compound 3-variable form.
Every row is evaluated live and shown in the table.
Check the classification: tautology, contradiction or contingency.
title: Truth Table Generator
